# Data series

`candle.*` series advance once per bar, `block.*` series once per block. Read the current value with `.value` and older values with `.at(k)`.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`candle.open`](#candle-open) | Price of the bar's first block. |
| [`candle.high`](#candle-high) | Highest block price in the bar. |
| [`candle.low`](#candle-low) | Lowest block price in the bar. |
| [`candle.close`](#candle-close) | Price of the bar's last block so far. |
| [`candle.volume`](#candle-volume) | Alpha traded through the pool in the bar. |
| [`candle.turnover`](#candle-turnover) | TAO traded through the pool in the bar. |
| [`candle.trades`](#candle-trades) | Number of pool trades in the bar. |
| [`candle.time`](#candle-time) | Bar open time, ms since epoch (UTC). |
| [`candle.movingPrice`](#candle-movingprice) | protocol moving price at the bar's first block (bar-aligned; block.movingPrice is per block) |
| [`block.number`](#block-number) | Block height. |
| [`block.time`](#block-time) | Block timestamp, ms since epoch (UTC). |
| [`block.price`](#block-price) | Pool price after the block, TAO per alpha. |
| [`block.taoIn`](#block-taoin) | TAO in the pool. |
| [`block.alphaIn`](#block-alphain) | Alpha in the pool. |
| [`block.alphaOut`](#block-alphaout) | Alpha outstanding (staked outside the pool). |
| [`block.movingPrice`](#block-movingprice) | The protocol's moving (smoothed) price. |
| [`block.trades`](#block-trades) | Pool trades in the block. |
| [`block.volume`](#block-volume) | alpha traded through the pool per block; in quick mode sampled per bar like the other block.* series |
| [`block.turnover`](#block-turnover) | TAO traded through the pool per block; in quick mode sampled per bar like the other block.* series |

## Types

### Series {#series}

A numeric time series aligned to bars (candle.*, ta.*) or blocks (block.*).

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | Current value; NaN before the series has history. (read-only) |
| `at` | `(k: number): number` | Value k steps ago (k = 0 is the current value). NaN beyond history. |
| `length` | `number` | Number of values available so far. (read-only) |
| `firstValid` | `number` | Index of the first non-NaN value, or -1. (read-only) |
| `alignment` | `"bar" \| "block"` | Alignment of this series. (read-only) |
| `valueOf` | `(): number` | Lets `+fast` and `fast - slow` work in plain JS; comparisons should use .value. |

### BoolSeries {#boolseries}

Boolean-valued series (ta.crossover etc.). `.value` is 0/1; `.at(k)` likewise.

`BoolSeries extends Series`

### SeriesLike {#serieslike}

A series, or a constant number used as a flat series (e.g. `ta.crossover(rsi, 30)`).

```ts
type SeriesLike = Series | number
```
